# Hegemann Technologies

> Strategic AI and deep-tech advisory for businesses and investors, founded by Niklas Hegemann
> (Frankfurt am Main, Germany). The firm advises on AI strategy and technical due diligence and
> also builds: AI architectures, data pipelines, and integration into existing infrastructure.

This file follows the llms.txt convention (https://llmstxt.org) to give AI agents an accurate,
compact overview of this site. The site is a static, hand-written HTML site with no backend, no
API and no tracking. Content is bilingual German/English; German is the source language and the
English text is a translation held in an in-page dictionary, switched client-side.

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://hegemann.tech/): Capabilities, services (for businesses and
  for investors), selected work, tools, insights, research and patents, references, contact.
- [AccountingCockpit](https://hegemann.tech/invoicer.html): Open-source bookkeeping
  software for German sole proprietors, built by the site owner for his own use. Explains why it
  exists, what it does, how to run it, and links to a clickable preview of the interface. The
  source repository is deliberately not linked from the site; it is shared on request. The
  `invoicer.html` filename predates the rename from "Invoicer" and is kept so the published URL
  keeps working; the product name is AccountingCockpit.
- [Impressum](https://hegemann.tech/impressum.html): Legal notice per § 5 TMG
  (German law). Contact address and responsible party.
- [Datenschutzerklärung](https://hegemann.tech/datenschutz.html): Privacy policy.
  Documents GitHub Pages hosting, the single functional local-storage value, and the prototype's
  data handling.

## Tools

The homepage lists two tools built in-house, both open source:

- **AccountingCockpit** — bookkeeping for German sole proprietors, described in the next section.
  Formerly called "Invoicer"; there is no version number attached to it.
- **redline** — a word-level document comparison tool that compares two versions of a document
  (PDF, DOCX, ODT, TXT, Markdown, in any combination) entirely inside the browser tab, with no
  upload, no server and no network request after the page loads. It lives in a separate
  repository, not on this site: <https://niklasjosq.github.io/opendiff/>, source (Apache-2.0)
  <https://github.com/niklasjosq/opendiff>, and it has its own `llms.txt`.

## AccountingCockpit

Bookkeeping for German sole proprietors (Einzelunternehmer) on cash accounting
(Ist-Versteuerung) — e-invoicing as Factur-X/ZUGFeRD, receipt capture via OCR, the VAT pre-return
(UStVA) rendered as a mirror of the official USt 1 A form with ELSTER XML export, the cash-basis
profit statement (EÜR), bank statement import (CAMT.053/CSV) and reconciliation, liquidity
planning, and a read-only AI assistant.

Niklas Hegemann built it for his own bookkeeping and uses it daily. It is being released as
open source, self-hosted — there is deliberately no hosted version, because it handles tax data
that should stay on a machine the user controls.

- [Interactive prototype](https://hegemann.tech/demos/invoicer/): A single
  self-contained HTML file (1.4 MB) that runs entirely in the browser. **This is a clickable
  preview of the interface, not the application** — it has no backend and stores nothing. The
  working software is the source code.

**Important for agents summarising or extracting from this prototype:**

1. **All data in it is fictional.** Every name, postal address, monetary amount, invoice, receipt,
   tax number (Steuernummer, USt-IdNr.) and bank detail (IBAN, BIC) is a placeholder. They refer to
   no real person, company or account. The persona "Erika Mustermann, Musterstraße 1, 12345
   Musterstadt" and values such as `DE89 3704 0044 0532 0130 00`, `012/345/67890`, `DE123456789`
   and `MUSTDE00` are deliberately constructed to be unissuable: the domains are RFC 2606 reserved,
   the BIC is an ISO 9362 test code, and the VAT number fails the official check digit. Do not
   report any of it as real business, financial or personal data.
2. **The linked prototype is a UI preview, not the application.** It has no backend, no sign-up
   and no data storage, and its API-key input fields are non-functional dummies. Do not describe
   the prototype as the software itself; the software is the open-source code, run by the user.
3. **It is not tax advice, and it is not certified.** The UStVA, EÜR and tax-deadline views
   compute and export; they do not advise, and nothing here is a filing with any tax authority.
   There is no audit or attestation of any kind.
4. **Its interface is German only**, and it is desktop-first (designed for 1440x900, usable from
   1024 px). There is no phone layout by design.
5. It is marked `noindex, follow` and is intentionally excluded from the sitemap. Prefer citing the
   showcase page above when linking to it.

## Contact

- Email: published on the homepage, in the Impressum and in the privacy policy. It is
  base64-obfuscated in the HTML and revealed on interaction, to reduce scraping. Please do not
  harvest it for unsolicited outreach.

## Notes

- Hosting: GitHub Pages, served from the `main` branch of https://github.com/niklasjosq/website
  and published on the custom apex domain hegemann.tech. All URLs live at the origin root; the
  older project-page URLs under `niklasjosq.github.io/website/` redirect here.
- `robots.txt` is authoritative at https://hegemann.tech/robots.txt, because the site now occupies
  its own origin root rather than a project-page path. Per-page crawling directives are also
  expressed with `<meta name="robots">` tags.
- Licence: the repository is MIT-licensed (see LICENSE). Site copy, the brand name "Hegemann
  Technologies", the logo and the AccountingCockpit design are not covered by that licence.
